How it works

From flooded to filed, in four steps

01

You call

Anytime — 24/7 emergency service, no set hours published. Tell us what happened, or send the summary this page builds for you.

02

We stop the damage

Water extraction, drying and dehumidifying for water; board-up, soot and odor work for fire; containment for mold.

03

Photos, moisture readings and a room-by-room record — the file your insurer actually needs to pay the claim.

Direct insurance billing

The bill shouldn't be your second emergency

Most homeowners' policies cover sudden water, fire and related mold damage — but the claim lives or dies on documentation. ASAP builds the file from the first visit and bills your insurer directly.

  • Photo & moisture documentation from day one
  • Room-by-room scope your adjuster can verify
  • Direct billing — no chasing reimbursement paperwork
  • Not sure you're covered? Call and ask before work starts
